_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the Honeypot Discord bot (https://github.com/RiskyMH/honeypot). Import via Admin > Nests > Import Egg. Based on the official generic Bun egg.
name: Honeypot Discord Bot
author: RiskyMH/honeypot
description: Honeypot Discord bot: automatically catches and removes spam bots via a dedicated honeypot channel. Needs only a DISCORD_TOKEN, no ports required.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then bun install; fi; bun src/bot.ts

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Honeypot Discord Bot - Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apt update
apt install -y git curl unzip
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "User upload mode, skipping install."
    exit 0
fi

## add git ending if it is not on the address
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

## pull repo or update existing checkout
if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo -e "Pulling latest changes."
        git pull
    else
        echo -e "Files found with no git config, leaving untouched to not break anything."
        exit 10
    fi
else
    echo -e "Cloning Honeypot repository."
    if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
        echo -e "Cloning default branch."
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        echo -e "Cloning branch ${BRANCH}."
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

## make sure bun exists in the installer container
if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo -e "Installing Bun."
    curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | BUN_INSTALL=/usr/local bash
fi

echo -e "Installing dependencies."
bun install --production

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed."
echo "Set your DISCORD_TOKEN variable, then start the server."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Discord Token
variables.description: Discord bot token (REQUIRED). Get it from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: SQLite or Postgres connection string. Defaults to a local sqlite file (persists in server files).

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Optional. Only needed for sharded/websocket proxy mode.

variables.name: Has Message Intent
variables.description: Optional. Set to 1 if your bot has the message content intent enabled.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: The Git branch to install (empty = default branch).

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip the install steps if you upload files yourself.
0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description:
Pull the latest files on startup when using a Git repository.
0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Has Message Intent
variables.description: Set to 1 if Message Content Intent is enabled in the Developer Portal (enables forward-message and ensure-msg-delete).

variables.name: Stats Port
variables.description: Port for the stats dashboard and health endpoint. Falls back to the panel allocation port automatically.

variables.name: Discord Client Secret
variables.description: Only needed for the mod dashboard login (Developer Portal > General Information).

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Public base URL of this server, e.g. https://stats.example.com. Only needed for the mod dashboard login (must be https).

variables.name: Invite URL
variables.description: Custom invite link shown by /stats. Defaults to this bot's own invite link.

variables.name: Stats Page URL
variables.description: Link target of the Live Stats button. Defaults to the official stats page.
